parameters.name: Pawn first move
parameters.description: How far a pawn may move along its ray on its first move. There is no en passant.
parameters.source: Owner decision D3, 2026-10-21: one square by default, two squares as a rule option.

parameters.name: Captures on the first move
parameters.description: Whether each side may capture on its first move.

options.label: No captures on either side's first move

parameters.source: Owner decision D7, 2026-10-21: allowed by default, no first-move captures as a rule option.
